jobs.description: Join our team in Bonn as Change Manager, starting as soon as possible (fixed-term position for 1 year)The Finance Systems Transformation Team is responsible for running the SHAPE+ program - a DHL Group wide cross-divisional Finance transformation program. The University Hospital Bonn (UKB) is one of Germany’s leading university hospitals, combining top-level performance in medicine and research with excellence in teaching. Each year, more than half a million patients receive inpatient and outpatient care at the UKB. Around 3,500 students study medicine and dentistry here, and over 600 people are trained annually in healthcare professions. With approximately 9,900 employees, the UKB is the third-largest employer in the Bonn/Rhein-Sieg region. In the Focus hospital ranking, the UKB ranks first among university hospitals in North Rhine-Westphalia and second nationwide in terms of case mix index (case severity). In 2024, the UKB raised nearly €100 million in third-party funding for research, development, and teaching. The F.A.Z. Institute has named the UKB “Germany’s Training Champion” and “Germany’s Most Attractive Employer” for the fourth consecutive year.The following full-/part-time position (38.5/19.5 hours per week)  is to be filled as soon as possible in the Institute for Hygiene and Public Health, Section Global Child Health of the University Hospital Bonn:Scientific coordinator (m/f/d)The Section of Global Child Health was established in November 2025 with the appointment of the Endowed Professorship in Global Child Health. The Section’s remit includes research and teaching in Germany and internationally, as well as clinical practice and the applied, practice-oriented engagement with global health challenges affecting children and adolescents. The professorship is structured as a tandem appointment with a corresponding position at the University of Malawi, based in Lilongwe.You will work in close collaboration with the section head in establishing sound research and communication networks with partners in Malawi and GermanyThe professorship focuses on research in the area of neonatal, child, and adolescent health in “Low and Middle Income Countries” (LMICs), identifies barriers to and solutions for improving global child health, and facilitates the transfer of epidemiological and clinical evidence into health care services with the goal of improving the health status of all children globally.It facilitates institutional, national and international networking and collaboration with universities, academic institutions and key development partners.In addition, it provides academic and health policy advice to national and international governmental as well as non-governmental organizations with regard to global child health.The position is initially limited to three years and remunerated according to TV-L EG 13 (German tax ID is a prerequisite). If you currently live abroad, you should be willing to relocate to Germany temporarily. Subject to interest and feasibility, a temporary increase in the scope of employment through third-party funded resources is envisaged.Tasks:This position offers the opportunity to actively contribute to the development of global strategies for improving children's health and to build and design a completely new international research and education structure.- Strategic coordination and management of international research, education and clinical programmes across the two professorships and the EKFS network- Planning, coordination, and monitoring of cross-institutional activities with academic and non-academic partners- Management of communication channels between institutions, disciplines, and countries, ensuring efficient information flow and alignment of activities- Coordination, and implementation of training materials and structured capacity-building programmes in collaboration with international experts- Planning, organisation, and delivery of international workshops and seminars in online and on-site formats- Preparation of annual progress and impact reports, dissemination of results through conferences and other scientific communication formats- Contribution to the strategic development, coordination, and drafting of third-party funding proposals to expand and sustain programme activitiesRequirements:- A full academic degree at Master’s level or higher in a health-related discipline- A strong interest in global child health and international health systems cooperation- Demonstrated experience in project coordination and research management- Excellent organisational skills and a structured, meticulous approach to work- Proven ability to navigate academic hierarchies and university administrative processes, combined with sensitivity to intercultural contexts- Strong teamwork skills, resilience, and the ability to assert and represent set positions- Full professional proficiency in both German and English, written and spoken Willingness to maintain an appropriate on-site presence at the university in Bonn- Previous extended study, research, or professional experience in a low- or middle-income country would be considered a strong assetWe offer: An interesting and challenging job in a modern research institution with attractive research infrastructures and a cooperative and communicative institute culture. This includes:- **Responsible and diverse: **A position with significant scope for initiative and development within a truly collegial and supportive team- **Fair compensation: **Pay according to the TV-L collective agreement, including annual bonus and company pension scheme- **Family-friendly flexibility: **Flexible working time models, access to a place in our company daycare center, and programs supporting employees returning from parental leave- **Smart commuting: **Excellent connection to the SWB public transport network and the option of an interest-free loan for the purchase of an e-bike- **Supported development: **Individual training opportunities through courses, e-learning programs, and coaching sessions- **Structured onboarding: **A systematic introduction to your new role and team- **Healthy at work: **A wide range of health and wellness programs, plus free membership at the UKB fitness studio- **Employee benefits: **Access to discounted offers for employees (corporate benefits)We are committed to diversity and equal opportunities. jobs.occupation: IT Security Specialist, Security Operations - Aarhus or Gdansk
jobs.description:
Are you driven by detecting, investigating and stopping security threats, and do you want to help strengthen how a global company protects its business every day?

“Our Security Operations team protects Arla’s systems and data around the clock. In this role, you will take ownership of key parts of our detection and response capabilities, work closely with our security service providers to continuously improve them, and share your expertise with colleagues across IT,” says Poul Henrik Tang Jensen, Senior Manager, Head of IT Product.

How you will make an impact

You will join IT Security Operations within IT Foundation, where you will take ownership of assigned Security Operations capabilities across endpoint, identity, network, application and cloud environments. Our technology landscape includes Microsoft and Palo Alto security technologies across SIEM, XDR, endpoint and identity.

You will work closely with our managed security service providers, who perform much of the day-to-day security monitoring, investigation and technical execution. Your role is to ensure these services deliver the detection, response and protection capabilities Arla needs.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• 
Taking ownership of assigned Security Operations capabilities and ensuring they remain effective, relevant and aligned with Arla’s risks and business needs.

• 
Overseeing security monitoring and investigations performed by our managed security service providers, challenging findings and providing technical direction on complex cases and incidents.

• 
Coordinating incident response across service providers and internal teams, including containment, eradication, recovery, escalation and follow-up.

• 
Driving improvements to detection rules, correlation logic, automation workflows and incident-response playbooks, working with our service providers on implementation.

• 
Assessing vulnerabilities and security-control weaknesses

• 
Managing the technical quality and performance of our security service providers, setting priorities and ensuring agreed improvements are implemented.

• 
Providing practical, risk-based security advice and assessments to projects and product teams.

• 
Leading Security Operations improvement initiatives and sharing security expertise across IT.

What will make you successful

You take ownership and follow issues through to a clear conclusion. When a security incident unfolds, you remain calm, analytical and decisive. You are comfortable working independently, while recognising when collaboration or escalation is needed. The ideal candidate brings:

• A relevant bachelor’s or master’s degree in IT, cybersecurity or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

• Typically 5+ years of relevant cybersecurity experience, including substantial experience within Security Operations, security monitoring, investigation and incident response.

• Experience taking ownership of complex security investigations, incidents or operational security improvements, including coordinating technical activities across internal teams and external security providers.

• Solid technical knowledge of SIEM, SOAR, EDR, network and identity-security monitoring, and vulnerability management.

• Practical understanding of attacker techniques and security frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK, NIST and ISO 27001.

• Good understanding of security logging, telemetry, evidence collection and forensic-analysis principles.

• Good understanding of security queries, scripting and automation, enabling you to assess technical solutions, challenge implementation choices and drive improvements with security service providers.

• Experience working with and providing technical direction to managed security service providers, while collaborating effectively with internal technology and product teams.

• A relevant professional security certification, or equivalent demonstrable expertise.

• Experience with technologies such as Microsoft Sentinel, Defender XDR, KQL, Palo Alto or similar enterprise security platforms would be an advantage.

What do we offer?

This position is based in either Aarhus, Denmark or Gdansk, Poland. You will be part of an on-call rotation, approximately every seventh week, to provide support in case of critical issues.

You will join a skilled and collaborative IT Security Operations team with a central role in protecting a global market leader. You will have real ownership of our Security Operations capabilities and the opportunity to lead technical workstreams and improvement initiatives.

Would you like to join us?

If you want to help keep Arla secure and make our Security Operations capabilities even stronger, we would love to hear from you. Please apply as soon as possible, as we review applications on an ongoing basis and may close the recruitment once the right candidate has been found.

For more information, please contact Poul Henrik Tang Jensen, Senior Manager, Head of IT Product Security Operations, at pohtj@arlafoods.com.

Procurement Category Manager for Filling equipment (Capex), Aarhus, Düsseldorf or Bremen.

Are you ambitious, driven, and looking to make a significant impact in a fast-changing environment, where you will take lead to ensure sourcing of production equipment to our dairies is optimized and cost competitive? And, do you know how to set strategic direction for your category, build and lead supplier relations to ensure a compliant and competitive supplier portfolio?

You will join a team of procurement colleagues, whom are passionate to ensure that the supplier base availably for production equipment is not just capable to deliver to quality and standards fit for future, they are also dedicated to ensure healthy competition in sourcing projects. Together with key stakeholders, we define the required sourcing strategy ahead and we aim to manage supplier relations accordingly,” says Procurement Senior Director Ninna Normand Helles.

How You Will Make an Impact

Being based in one of our offices in either Aarhus, Düsseldorf or Bremen, you will take global ownership of the Capex category of filling equipment. You will take lead to define, execute and mature the category strategies. You will manage strategic Supplier Relations and ensure to define and manage a portfolio of compliance and relevant suppliers within your category to ensure competitive sourcing can be performed in all capex projects and tenders.

Besides your category responsibility, you will take sourcing lead of key Capex projects and engage actively with the Project Manager to ensure relevant, compliant and competitive supplier selection in the project. This included definition of tender packages in the project, creation of sourcing plan in alignment with the project team, selection and onboarding of suppliers, management of tenders, negotiations and finalization of contracts.

Successfully navigating the complexity of your sourcing projects as well as your designated sourcing category, your key responsibilities will include:

• Defining and driving Category strategy, commitment and engagement of key stakeholders and execution of relevant actions to deploy strategic direction.

• Ensure a compliant and relevant supplier portfolio in your category by establishing framework agreements with relevant suppliers to cover business demand and ensure competition.

• Establishing, developing and lead strong, long-lasting and dynamic supplier relationships and ensure annual SRM plans are conducted.

• Lead and manage execution all sourcing activities in key Capex projects with high level of complexity and time dependencies, including sourcing plan, supplier selection, tendering, negotiation and contracting.

• Set sourcing and negotiation strategy and take lead to execute accordingly to ensure competitive sourcing and objective supplier evaluation and rewarding.

• Working closely together with key stakeholder internally to ensure successful and competitive execution of sourcing projects.

• Conduct supplier and site visits to maintain knowledge of equipment and competences and challenges among suppliers as well as internally at Arla sites.

In terms of travel, you can expect approximately 20-30 days per year to maintain supplier relations and visit Arla dairies at various locations in Europe.

What Will Make You Successful

Your qualifications include a Master’s degree and at least 5 years of experience in a similar role from a global organization. Your innate project management mindset, coupled with strong analytical skills, allows you to seamlessly transition from a high-level strategic view to execution and diving deep for valuable insights. You excel in business partnering, building positive relationships, and effectively managing stakeholders at all levels of the organization. Your thoughtful communication and flexible project management ensure smooth and efficient processes.

Having profound understanding of complex negotiations, capex contracts, and the commercial and strategic aspects behind them is equally important in this role. Your experience therefor includes, but is not limited to:

• At least 5 years of extensive experience in strategic sourcing related to Capex/production equipment.

• Profound experience as sourcing lead of complex tender projects and negotiations.

• Experienced Category Management and know how to set and drive a category strategy, and how to establish a compliant and relevant supplier portfolio for your category.

• Good technical understanding and knowledge of Capex/production equipment and understanding of the supplier base across capex categories. Specific knowledge from the food and beverage industry, is a considerable advantage.

• Your fluency in spoken and written English is excellent.

You are fearless when it comes to challenging the status quo, and your courage and exceptional stakeholder management skills empower you to negotiate effectively and rally the right individuals when introducing new ideas. Your genuine interest in our business field drives you to proactively conduct research, ensuring a deep understanding of the global supply market. You thrive in a dynamic, international work environment where objectives and priorities are continuously evolving and developing.

What Do We Offer?

Join a high-performing team with a great culture and spirit, where you’ll have the opportunity to develop your skills and make a real impact. At Arla, we’re committed to professional growth and promoting from within. Our positive and collaborative culture brings out the best in everyone, and you’ll be part of a market leader that produces nutritious, household-favorite brands in a sustainable way - benefiting customers, our farmer-owners, and the world.

Would You Like to Join Us?

We are conducting interviews for this position on an ongoing basis, so please apply as soon as possible. For additional information, please submit our application without further hesitation, as we will close the recruitment when the right candidate has been found.

In case of further questions, you may contact Procurement Senior Director Ninna Normand Helles at ninoh@arlafoods.com

Our global procurement organization is spread across Denmark, Sweden, Germany, the Netherlands, UK, Poland, and Hong Kong. This position will report to Senior Procurement Director of Capex, MRO, utilities and chemicals.

**Job Description Summary

**The Production Engineer – Calibration & Maintenance is responsible for the calibration, maintenance, and lifecycle management of production, inspection, measurement, and test equipment used in a regulated medical device manufacturing environment.

The role works closely with Manufacturing, Engineering, Quality, equipment owners, and external service providers to ensure equipment remains calibrated, maintained, compliant, and available for production.

Responsibilities include day-to-day calibration and preventive maintenance coordination, HxGN EAM administration, calibration assessments, controlled procedures and work instructions, supplier coordination, and equipment compliance.

This is a hands-on Production Engineering role supporting manufacturing operations across scanner/system assembly, mechanical and electrical/electronic assembly, software configuration/loading, packaging and labeling, and testing/final acceptance.

**Job Description

****Roles & Responsibilities

**

• Coordinate the site calibration program, including calibration schedules, call-in activities, equipment status, due dates, and timely completion.

• Coordinate internal and external calibration activities, including equipment preparation, shipment, return, documentation review, and release back to production.

• Ensure new, returned, overdue, failed, or out-of-tolerance equipment is appropriately assessed and controlled before use.

• Act as SME for calibration and maintenance activities in HxGN EAM, maintaining asset records, calibration setups, preventive maintenance schedules, work orders, task plans, and supporting documentation.

• Perform and support calibration assessments, including equipment requirements, criticality, acceptance criteria, calibration methods, frequencies, and maintenance needs.

• Develop and maintain calibration and maintenance procedures, SOPs, and work instructions in collaboration with equipment owners, SMEs, and Quality.

• Coordinate preventive and corrective maintenance activities for production and test equipment while minimizing disruption to manufacturing.

• Support investigations, risk assessments, and product-impact assessments related to overdue, failed, or out-of-tolerance equipment, and provide input to NC/INV/CAPA activities where applicable.

• Coordinate external calibration and maintenance suppliers, including quotations, service activities, documentation, and AGORA purchase orders.

• Support internal and external audits by ensuring calibration and maintenance records are complete, traceable, compliant, and audit-ready.

• Monitor calibration and maintenance performance and drive improvements in equipment compliance, availability, data quality, and execution efficiency.

**Required Qualifications

**

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Industrial Engineering, Metrology, Maintenance, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.

• Experience with calibration, preventive maintenance, equipment management, or Production Engineering in a regulated manufacturing environment.

• Understanding of calibration principles, equipment control, documentation, traceability, and manufacturing process requirements.

• Experience with computerized maintenance or Enterprise Asset Management systems, preferably HxGN EAM or comparable systems.

• Experience working within controlled procedures, work instructions, and change management processes.

• Experience coordinating suppliers, service activities, quotations, and purchase orders.

• Knowledge of GMP and Quality Management System requirements within regulated manufacturing.

**Desired Characteristics

**

• Experience within medical device manufacturing or another highly regulated manufacturing environment.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail.

• Hands-on and practical approach to supporting manufacturing equipment and production operations.

• Structured working style with strong ownership and ability to manage recurring deadlines.

• Strong collaboration skills across Manufacturing, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, and external suppliers.

• Clear written and verbal communication skills.

• Comfortable balancing equipment compliance, production continuity, quality requirements, and operational priorities.

• Proactive and improvement-focused approach to equipment reliability and calibration/maintenance processes

******Additional Information

******Relocation Assistance Provided: No

As our new Test Manager, you will play a key role in delivering our SitaWare and Iris suites, an integrated, ultra-modern command-and-control toolset that helps Defence customers make critical decisions wherever they need it. You will apply your broad test and engineering skills in an agile environment with highly skilled colleagues, as part of our growing Defence Services team in Copenhagen.

The job

Our SitaWare and Iris suites give armed forces an integrated, ultra-modern command-and-control toolset spanning radio, mobile, vehicle, web and application-based solutions, with real-time reporting back to command HQ. As our new Test Manager, you will be involved in everything from the start of a feature, writing test cases and managing the process, through to verifying the final testing before we deliver the solution to our Defence customers.

In short, you can look forward to:

• Planning and conducting acceptance tests (FAT and SAT) with customers, both at our own facilities and at customer sites

• Conducting integration tests with third-party software and hardware

• Challenging solution design against risks, based on system context, customer requirements and security

• Taking part in military exercises to support the use of our solutions and find new ways of testing that reflect real-life use

• Establishing and maintaining test environments, and contributing to tender and proposal work on test and test management approach

You should expect travel within the Nordics, and potentially elsewhere in Europe, several times a year.

Joining the team

You will join a small but growing team in a brand-new office in the heart of Copenhagen, working closely with your Nordic colleagues while also collaborating with other teams across our global constellations. Testing is an integral part of our development process, and you will be part of a wider community of testers and test managers, with knowledge-network events to exchange ideas, hear lectures, share best practice and get to know your colleagues. It is an agile, fast-moving environment with flexible, trust-based working hours and plenty of room for personal responsibility.

Your qualifications

To succeed in this role, you bring:

• A technical degree, Bachelor's or Master's

• Solid experience as a Test Manager or in a similar role, with strong technical skills

• Experience with test management tools such as TestRail and Jira, including the Xray and R4J plugins

• Hands-on experience with test execution in close cooperation with stakeholders, and the ability to analyse and communicate technically complex solutions

• Solid knowledge of Windows and Linux environments, SQL/MS SQL Server, Active Directory, and networking fundamentals (IP, TCP, UDP, multicast, routing, firewalls), along with scripting skills in PowerShell or Bash

• Fluent Danish and English

• The ability to understand product requirements and translate these into effective tests

Alongside this, we value:

• Enjoys working in a changing environment, eager to step outside your comfort zone to make a difference

• Highly motivated to develop and apply your technical skills in a broad, technical role

• Enjoys customer-facing activities such as presentations, technical support, training and testing, building the trust that drives customer satisfaction

• Self-motivated and committed, with a hands-on approach

ISTQB or TMAP certification, automated testing experience, or experience with testing standards such as ISO/IEEE 29119, ISO 25010 or ISO 9001 are an advantage.

Experience with radio networking (e.g. VHF, HF) or tactical communications systems is a strong plus.

jobs.occupation: Customer Success Manager, Defence - From implementation to operational value
jobs.description:
How do you turn a technically implemented defence solution into a capability that customers actively use, value and keep developing?

We are looking for a Customer Success Manager, Defence, to help our customers get the full operational value from SitaWare, from go-live and beyond. The role is built for a former military officer who has used SitaWare in the field, in headquarters, exercises or operations, and knows what it takes for a command-and-control system to make a real difference to the people who depend on it.

You will be a trusted partner for our customers and a key link between them and our internal teams in Service Delivery, Sales, Product and Development.

The job

Once a customer goes live on SitaWare, the real value journey begins.

Drawing on your operational experience, you will understand how customers use the solution today, where gaps exist between available capabilities and the way the organisation actually works, and where we can help them achieve greater operational value.

The job includes:

• Building strong, long-term relationships and becoming the customer’s trusted Customer Success partner.

• Translating each customer’s strategic, operational and tactical objectives into clear Customer Success outcomes, speaking the language of commanders and staff officers.

• Driving adoption of SitaWare and identifying opportunities to move customers from basic implementation towards deeper and broader use.

• Using your hands-on experience with SitaWare Headquarters, Frontline and Edge to show units how the solution supports their procedures, battle rhythm and command processes.

• Developing customer-specific value cases showing the financial and operational impact of proposed improvements.

• Leading improvement initiatives from opportunity identification through implementation to value realisation.

• Identifying opportunities for new use cases, services and expansion based on customer needs and demonstrated value.

• Capturing and sharing customer insights and best practices so successful approaches can scale across customers.

Joining the team

You will join our growing Service Development organisation, which brings together expertise in military operations, defence, technology, service development and business development.

Customer Success is a developing capability here, giving you the chance to help shape how we work with customers after implementation.

Your qualifications

Essential:

You have served as an officer at the rank of Captain (OF-2) or higher, with operational experience as a user of SitaWare products from exercises, deployments or staff work.

In addition, the optimal candidate has:

• A relevant bachelor’s degree or higher and significant experience from customer-facing, consulting, project, service, product or business development work

• Experience as a customer’s named point of contact for value and adoption, and in delivering improvement projects end to end, tracking operational and financial value and turning proven results into repeatable offerings

• Experience translating customer needs into concrete solutions and business outcomes, including business cases that demonstrate financial and operational value

• Commercial awareness and the ability to identify customer growth and expansion opportunities

• Strong stakeholder management skills, including credibility with senior military leaders, staff officers and end users

• The ability to work across Product, Sales, Service Delivery and Development

• Excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken.

As a person you are proactive and structured, with the ability to operate independently in an evolving environment.

You bring the credibility of someone who has served and led in the military. You are collaborative, curious and solution-oriented, build trust easily, take ownership and are comfortable challenging existing ways of working when it creates better outcomes for the customer.

You are willing to travel approximately 60-70 days per year. The position can be based in Aarhus or Copenhagen.

Please note that, as we work on security-classified projects, you must be able to present a clean criminal record and have lived in a NATO and/or EU country for the past seven years. Read more here.
